title: One Boat Returns
short_role: Choose supplies or morale when the divided defense reaches its first recovery.
setup: Only one ferry returns before the next alarm. It can carry repair timber or evacuate the shaken watch.

choices.label: Unload repair timber (+4 materials)
choices.visible_result: Four materials support later repairs; morale receives no relief.

choices.label: Evacuate the shaken watch (+1 morale)
choices.visible_result: Morale recovers by one; the repair budget remains unchanged.
